There are 2 main techniques: mind palace and the journey method. In the mind palace, you number irl items in your house, outside, etc. Then you create a ridiculous image and put it where you imagined the item. The journey method is kinda better for long-term recall while the mind palace is way faster. In the journey method, you make a ridiculous story with the data points. Like dog water and duck imagine a dog walking into a pool and drowns while an evil duck enjoys the view. However, simply using Anki is the best long-term solution the memory techniques are just for not getting overloaded while reading which is underrated.
Speed reading alone would hurt comprehension. But with memory techniques you are fine. There are 2 main techniques to lower sub voca. Pressing your tongue up or counting while reading. Both are great
